text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: embeddings-api (prod, us-west-2) — 95th pct latency > 1800ms for 10m. Severity: P1. Paging logan (oncall). link: https://dash.redwood/alerts/embeddings-95p

logan: acked. joining bridge now. pulling SLO dashboard and recent deploys.

ops-bot: bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/2126789012 (password protected). Recording enabled.

anya: oncall here — if you want to hand off, go ahead, otherwise I'll take. what's the error profile?

logan: handing to @anya — I saw a spike right after the rolling deploy at 2126788000. latency heatmap shows long tails on larger requests (>2k tokens).

kevin: adding observability comments — tails coincide with kv-cache misses and high garbage collection on a subset of hosts. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeddings/latency?range=30m

maria: are customers impacted? which ones?

anya: initial check: 2% of requests are timing out (504), mostly from batch jobs for partner A and internal nightly indexing. No broad user-facing errors yet. customer-facing API success rate still ~98% but unacceptable for SLO.

logan: quick mitigation idea: scale dedicated pool + temporary routing to fallback quantized model (smaller memory footprint). can we enable auto-burst?

kevin: we can push an autoscale override for the dedicated pool now. also recommend enabling prefix caching for the high-volume batching clients.

anya: doing controlled mitigation: 1) enable autoscale override to +30% capacity (now) 2) route non-critical partner jobs to fallback model variant v2-q4 3) add short-term 5s client-side retry. I'll coordinate.

logan: :thumbsup: please post commands you run so we have audit trail.

anya: commands:
```
# scale override
redwoodctl pools set --pool embeddings-pool-usw2 --capacity-override 1.3
# route rule
redwoodctl routing create --match partner:partnerA --model v2-q4 --priority low --ttl 10m
```

ops-bot: action taken: capacity override applied by anya at 2126789255. routing rule created (ttl 10m).

kevin: after override we see 95th drop to ~900ms within 3m. KV miss rate still high for some hosts, investigating GC and kernel metrics.

maria: I'll notify partner A's account team and CS: "We observed elevated embeddings latency; applied temporary routing and scaling to mitigate; will follow up with root cause and timeline."

logan: good. capture customer impact note in incident tracker (inc-2126789012) with who we notified + template.

anya: logging quick notes into tracker. next: can we prevent recurrence? initial hypotheses: 1) a model change increased peak memory usage 2) a traffic pattern unexpectedly increased batch sizes 3) some hosts had kernel compilation thrash after deploy.

kevin: looking at deploy logs: model artifact v2.3 landed at 2126787899, but only some replicas were updated; rollout was mixed (old+new). mixed-kernel combos can produce transient memory spikes.

logan: ok. plan for post-incident: schedule postmortem, identify owners for followups (routing rules, rollout process, alert tuning).

maria: availability — I can do the postmortem facilitation next Tue 1100-1200 PT. If others conflict, propose Wed 0900.

anya: Tue 11 works for me.

kevin: Tue 11 OK. I'll bring metrics and the dashboard.

logan: I'll be there too. please add to calendar: "inc-2126789012 postmortem" and invite eng-runtime, eng-sre, product, and CS lead for partner A.

ops-bot: calendar event created by ops-bot: Tue 11:00 PT — "inc-2126789012 postmortem". attendees: eng-runtime, eng-sre, product, cs-partnerA.

logan: action items for now (short-term):
- A1: kevin: full host GC/kv-cache analysis + identify guilty hosts (due EOD today)
- A2: anya: add a rollout gating check to detect mixed-kernel deployments and auto-rollback window (due +3d)
- A3: maria: customer comms summary + SLA impact note (due EOD today)
- A4: platform: tune embeddings 95p alert threshold and add dedupe window (due +2d)

kevin: acknowledging A1. starting host log export and flamegraphs.

anya: acknowledging A2. will draft runbook snippet and add to rollout pipeline: reject rollout if >20% mismatch after 5m.

maria: acknowledging A3. drafting note and will paste to incident tracker.

logan: for monitoring improvements we should consider: - changing paging rules so that a sustained 95p > 1.5s for 15m pages SRE, but transient spikes don't. - dedupe alerts across hosts (reduce noise) - add KV cache miss alert with lower threshold (early warning)

kevin: agreed. initial proposed alert YAML for team review:
```yaml
alert: EmbeddingsHighTail
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(embeddings_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, cluster)) > 1.5
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: high
  team: eng-runtime
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeddings-high-tail
```

anya: also propose a dedupe window: if same alert fires across >3 hosts within 30s, collapse into single page. and add a suppression rule for partner-background-batches to avoid paging during known nightly windows.

logan: note: suppression for partner jobs must be opt-in with CS approval — avoid hiding real user impact. maria, can you coordinate partner window gating?

maria: yes, will confirm with partner A on maintenance windows. won't suppress page for interactive traffic.

kevin: small followup: add a lightweight early-warning alert: KVCacheMissRate > 5% for 5m -> notify channel (no page) with link to cache heatmap.

ops-bot: created ticket MON-2126790001: "add embeddings early-warning and dedupe paging rule" assigned to kevin and anya. due +2d.

logan: final notes before closing bridge: 1) mitigation stable, 95p ~850ms 2) no ongoing customer-wide errors 3) postmortem Tue 11 4) action items and tickets created.

anya: closing bridge in 5m — will monitor for 30m and then hand back to rotation.

maria: thanks all. I'll paste the customer-facing blurb into the incident tracker and ping CS. :white_check_mark:

logan: document lessons in postmortem template: cause hypothesis (mixed rollout -> kernel/memory mismatch), mitigation (scale + fallback + routing), remediation (rollout gate + alert rewrites), followups (dedupe, KV early-warning).

kevin: uploading flamegraphs and HC metrics to inc-2126789012 artifact area. link: https://artifacts.redwood/inc-2126789012

ops-bot: bridge closed at 2126792200 by anya.

anya: handing back to rotation. will post summary slides to the postmortem doc.

logan: :eyes: thanks everyone. we'll run the postmortem and ensure the action items are tracked to closure.

(reacts: incident-bot message :rotating_light: by logan :white_check_mark:, ops-bot bridge creation message :eyes: by kevin)
